sloka: देवतानां हितार्थाय महात्मा वै पितामहः।उवाच देवताः सर्वा इदं तुष्टो महद्वचः ।। ६.९५.३२ ।।
transliteration: devatānāṁ hitārthāya mahātmā vai pitāmahaḥ।uvāca devatāḥ sarvā idaṁ tuṣṭo mahadvacaḥ ।। 6.95.32 ।।

translations.english: "Tormented by the oppression of Ravana, on account of the boon (given to him by the creator) and intensity of his austerities, the learned worshipped Brahma."
